name: cf-ratewatch-worker
description: cf-ratewatch on Cloudflare Workers: hour-scale per-IP limits for Cloudflare zones

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with Zone:Read, Analytics:Read and Firewall Services:Edit on the zones you protect (plus Account Firewall Access Rules:Edit for scope = "account").

METRICS_TOKEN.description: Optional. A random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Prometheus scrapes GET /metrics with it as a bearer token. Leave empty to keep /metrics off.

DRY_RUN.description: "true" logs what would be banned and changes nothing. Set to "false" once the logs look right.

CONFIG.description: Zones and thresholds, as JSON. Same schema as config.example.toml in the repository.
